s0601.literal: Beyond the Jiang-Zhe famine, epidemic disease broke out on a great scale; the dead lay piled one upon another.
s0601.idiomatic: Beyond the Jiang-Zhe famine, epidemic disease broke out on a great scale; the dead lay piled one upon another.

s0602.literal: Fathers sold their sons, husbands sold their wives; cries shook the countryside — unbearable to hear.
s0602.idiomatic: Fathers sold their sons, husbands sold their wives; cries shook the countryside — unbearable to hear.

s0603.literal: Your subjects are without talent yet unworthily bear heavy responsibility; though we wish to exhaust heart and strength, our knowledge and vision are shallow and narrow, our thoughts not broad — causing many errors in governance, contrary to the harmony of yin and yang; the common people suffer this calamity. We wish to retire and yield the path to the worthy.
s0603.idiomatic: Your subjects are without talent yet unworthily bear heavy responsibility; though we wish to exhaust heart and strength, our knowledge and vision are shallow and narrow, our thoughts not broad — causing many errors in governance, contrary to the harmony of yin and yang; the common people suffer this calamity. We wish to retire and yield the path to the worthy.

s0604.literal: " The Emperor said: "Disasters have their sources; it is not you who caused them. You need only be careful in your conduct.
s0604.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Disasters have their sources; it is not you who caused them. You need only be careful in your conduct.

s0605.literal: " The Qielian Household Intendant Office was established, rank primary fifth grade, four officials appointed.
s0605.idiomatic: " The Qielian Household Intendant Office was established, rank primary fifth grade, 4 officials appointed.

s0606.literal: King Wang Ju of Koryo died.
s0606.idiomatic: King Wang Ju of Koryo died.

s0607.literal: Seni Temuchai was ordered to govern the people of Semisqan.
s0607.idiomatic: Seni Temuchai was ordered to govern the people of Semisqan.

s0608.literal: On jiwei day the Central Domestic Affairs Court rank was raised to secondary first grade.
s0608.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Central Domestic Affairs Court rank was raised to secondary first grade.

s0609.literal: On xinyou day envoys were dispatched to princes Chapar and Kököchin.
s0609.idiomatic: On xinyou day envoys were dispatched to princes Chapar and Kököchin.

s0610.literal: On renxu day Grand Preceptor Toghto memorialized: "The great merchant Hajji Bitigi of Quanzhou presented rare agarwood sandalwood suitable for constructing palace buildings.
s0610.idiomatic: On renxu day grand preceptor Toghto memorialized, "The great merchant Hajji Bitigi of Quanzhou presented rare agarwood sandalwood suitable for constructing palace buildings.

s0611.literal: " An edict ordered the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat to transport it by relay post.
s0611.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat to transport it by relay post.

s0612.literal: On guihai day Wanhu Yelimen Qesan came from Semisqan and other cities, presenting the household blue register made in Taizu's time; silver notes, silks, and cloths were granted in varying amounts.
s0612.idiomatic: On guihai day wanhu Yelimen Qesan came from Semisqan and other cities, presenting the household blue register made in Taizu's time; silver notes, silks, and cloths were granted in varying amounts.

s0613.literal: On bingyin day Pu County suffered an earthquake.
s0613.idiomatic: On bingyin day Pu County suffered an earthquake.

s0614.literal: On guiyou day the Internal Historian's Office was promoted to Internal Historian's Bureau, primary second grade.
s0614.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Internal Historian's Office was promoted to Internal Historian's Bureau, primary second grade.

s0615.literal: On yihai day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0615.idiomatic: On yihai day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0616.literal: The liquor ban in all routes was relaxed.
s0616.idiomatic: The liquor ban in all routes was relaxed.

s0617.literal: On wuyin day the great merchant Mahmud of Quanzhou presented rarities, a precious belt, and a Western Region horse.
s0617.idiomatic: On wuyin day the great merchant Mahmud of Quanzhou presented rarities, a precious belt, and a Western Region horse.

s0618.literal: On gengchen day Wang Zhang was installed as king of Koryo.
s0618.idiomatic: On gengchen day Wang Zhang was installed as king of Koryo.

s0619.literal: Prince Duman presented the Taizong imperial jade seal in his collection; Duman was enfeoffed as Prince of Yangdi and granted a gold seal.
s0619.idiomatic: Prince Duman presented the Taizong imperial jade seal in his collection; Duman was enfeoffed as Prince of Yangdi and granted a gold seal.

s0620.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "By imperial order: because harvests failed in successive years, the four guards accompanying the court — each guard about four hundred men — their forage grain is given as in the usual case; that given to each unit is halved.
s0620.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "By imperial order: because harvests failed in successive years, the four guards accompanying the court — each guard about 400 men — their forage grain is given as in the usual case; that given to each unit is halved.

s0621.literal: Your subjects propose: last year in the capital, horses fed numbered ninety-four thousand; we now request reduction to fifty thousand; on outer routes horses fed numbered more than one hundred nineteen thousand; we now request reduction to sixty thousand — to take effect from the fifteenth of the tenth month.
s0621.idiomatic: Your subjects propose: last year in the capital, horses fed numbered 94,000; we now request reduction to 50,000; on outer routes horses fed numbered more than 119,000; we now request reduction to 60,000 — to take effect from the fifteenth of the tenth month.

s0622.literal: " They also said: "In Semisqan, Taras, and Tasixuan and other cities, three years of civilian taxes were delivered to district offices.
s0622.idiomatic: " They also said, "In Semisqan, Taras, and Tasixuan and other cities, 3 years of civilian taxes were delivered to district offices.

s0623.literal: Now because Seni Temuchai is going there, it should be ordered that two years' taxes be given to Kököchin, granted to those who originally delivered taxes, and one year's delivered upward.
s0623.idiomatic: Now because Seni Temuchai is going there, it should be ordered that 2 years' taxes be given to Kököchin, granted to those who originally delivered taxes, and 1 year's delivered upward.

s0625.literal: On guihai day the moon encroached upon Mars.
s0625.idiomatic: On guihai day the moon encroached upon Mars.

s0626.literal: The Central Capital Tiger Guard Office was established; by special appointment Lang She Ren and Direct Secretariat Attendant Cangjisha were granted Zishan dafu and made acting Quanfu Bureau superintendent.
s0626.idiomatic: The Central Capital Tiger Guard Office was established; by special appointment Lang She Ren and direct secretariat attendant Cangjisha were granted Zishan dafu and made acting Quanfu Bureau superintendent.

s0627.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengyin day a residence was built for Grand Preceptor El Temür; twenty thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0627.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengyin day, a residence was built for grand preceptor El Temür; 20,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0628.literal: On guisi day Pu and Ling counties suffered earthquakes.
s0628.idiomatic: On guisi day Pu and Ling counties suffered earthquakes.

s0629.literal: On jiawu day Ashabuhua was made privy council administrator.
s0629.idiomatic: On jiawu day Ashabuhua was made privy council administrator.

s0630.literal: On dingyou day, because Dadu faced grain scarcity, grain sale at reduced price was resumed for one hundred thousand shi to relieve the people; the notes from this were used for government grain purchase in Jiangnan.
s0630.idiomatic: On dingyou day, because Dadu faced grain scarcity, grain sale at reduced price was resumed for 100,000 shi to relieve the people; the notes from this were used for government grain purchase in Jiangnan.

s0631.literal: Dadu liquor monopoly was abolished; the Crown Prince was granted one thousand taels of gold.
s0631.idiomatic: Dadu liquor monopoly was abolished; the Crown Prince was granted 1,000 taels of gold.

s0632.literal: On xinchou day Venus encroached upon Southern Dipper.
s0632.idiomatic: On xinchou day Venus encroached upon Southern Dipper.

s0633.literal: On guimao day central secretariat officials requested that one hundred thousand shi of Huguang grain be stored at Yangzhou, three hundred thousand shi of Jiangxi and Jiang-Zhe sea-transport grain — of which fifty thousand shi stored at Zhuwang and Lijin warehouses — to aid Shandong famine victims. Approved.
s0633.idiomatic: On guimao day central secretariat officials requested that 100,000 shi of Huguang grain be stored at Yangzhou, 300,000 shi of Jiangxi and Jiang-Zhe sea-transport grain — of which 50,000 shi stored at Zhuwang and Lijin warehouses — to aid Shandong famine victims. Approved.

s0634.literal: Edict: "All who hold inner edict documents to buy Hejian salt and all who reach the salt transport office with words of princes and imperial sons-in-law — all forbidden;
s0634.idiomatic: Edict: "All who hold inner edict documents to buy Hejian salt and all who reach the salt transport office with words of princes and imperial sons-in-law — all forbidden;

s0635.literal: those holding inner edict documents that do not come through the central secretariat may be reported by the transport office.
s0635.idiomatic: those holding inner edict documents that do not come through the central secretariat may be reported by the transport office.

s0636.literal: " Hunting on commoner fields in Fengfu, Changqing, Sishui, Zhangqiu, Zhanhua, Lijin, and Wudi — seven counties — was forbidden.
s0636.idiomatic: " Hunting on commoner fields in Fengfu, Changqing, Sishui, Zhangqiu, Zhanhua, Lijin, and Wudi — 7 counties — was forbidden.

s0637.literal: On jiachen day, at the Imperial Preceptor's request, Buddhist affairs commissioner Dorjibal was also made intendant of Nangba land property and wealth, as darughachi of the overall administration bureau controlling its finances.
s0637.idiomatic: On jiachen day, at the Imperial Preceptor's request, Buddhist affairs commissioner Dorjibal was also made intendant of Nangba land property and wealth, as darughachi of the overall administration bureau controlling its finances.

s0638.literal: The Western Tibetan monk Jiao Waban was made Hanlin academician recipient.
s0638.idiomatic: The Western Tibetan monk Jiao Waban was made Hanlin academician recipient.

s0639.literal: Left chancellor and privy council administrator Temür Buhua was additionally made recorder of military and state weighty affairs.
s0639.idiomatic: Left chancellor and privy council administrator Temür Buhua was additionally made recorder of military and state weighty affairs.

s0640.literal: Central secretariat right vice director and Minister of Works Tolugh, Henan branch secretariat right vice director Yesü, and Internal Historian Tobuqa — all were made privy council administrators.
s0640.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice director and minister of works Tolugh, Henan branch secretariat right vice director Yesü, and internal historian Tobuqa — all were made privy council administrators.

s0641.literal: On yisi day the Huguo Renwang Temple Zhaoying Guiyun overall administration bureau was changed to Huifu Bureau, secondary second grade.
s0641.idiomatic: On yisi day the Huguo Renwang Temple Zhaoying Guiyun overall administration bureau was changed to Huifu Bureau, secondary second grade.

s0642.literal: On bingwu day the Xingsheng Palace medical superintendent office was established, primary third grade.
s0642.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Xingsheng Palace medical superintendent office was established, primary third grade.

s0643.literal: Eleventh month, on jiwei day, central secretariat officials said: "In Shizu times, the secretariat, privy council, censorate, and all offices each had fixed establishment; later there were slight increases — Chengzong already had an edict to consolidate offices.
s0643.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, central secretariat officials said, "In Shizu times, the secretariat, privy council, censorate, and all offices each had fixed establishment; later there were slight increases — Chengzong already had an edict to consolidate offices.

s0644.literal: Recently various offices have been promoted in succession — fourth grade to third, third to second, second to first; one office even reaches twenty or thirty positions; affairs unchanged from old yet officials daily increase.
s0644.idiomatic: Recently various offices have been promoted in succession — fourth grade to third, third to second, second to first; one office even reaches 20 or 30 positions; affairs unchanged from old yet officials daily increase.

s0645.literal: Request according to the fixed numbers established in the tenth year of Dade; redundant ones let each office reduce on its own.
s0645.idiomatic: Request according to the fixed numbers established in the tenth year of Dade; redundant ones let each office reduce on its own.

s0646.literal: Where offices were promoted, clerical staff should only be appointed at their old rank; where precedent applies, follow the selection regulations as usual.
s0646.idiomatic: Where offices were promoted, clerical staff should only be appointed at their old rank; where precedent applies, follow the selection regulations as usual.

s0648.literal: On gengshen day Venus appeared in daylight.
s0648.idiomatic: On gengshen day Venus appeared in daylight.

s0649.literal: Five thousand soldiers were supplied for temple construction corvée.
s0649.idiomatic: 5,000 soldiers were supplied for temple construction corvée.

s0650.literal: Officials' salaries were increased — Zhiyuan notes given according to Zhongtong note amounts, stopping their salary grain; amounting to four hundred thousand shi annually.
s0650.idiomatic: Officials' salaries were increased — Zhiyuan notes given according to Zhongtong note amounts, stopping their salary grain; amounting to 400,000 shi annually.

s0651.literal: Clerical staff by ninth-tenth month service for appointment, as in the old system.
s0651.idiomatic: Clerical staff by ninth-tenth month service for appointment, as in the old system.

s0652.literal: An edict remitted Shaoxing, Qingyuan, Taizhou, Jiankang, and Guangde field rent; Shaoxing was especially hard hit by disaster and this year drought again — all tenant households need only pay four-tenths to the landlord.
s0652.idiomatic: An edict remitted Shaoxing, Qingyuan, Taizhou, Jiankang, and Guangde field rent; Shaoxing was especially hard hit by disaster and this year drought again — all tenant households need only pay four-tenths to the landlord.

s0653.literal: Mountain passes, river marshes, and commercial taxes — cut off and remitted as of the date.
s0653.idiomatic: Mountain passes, river marshes, and commercial taxes — cut off and remitted as of the date.

s0654.literal: Where small harvests occurred in routes, confirm disaster areas and remit.
s0654.idiomatic: Where small harvests occurred in routes, confirm disaster areas and remit.

s0655.literal: On yichou day Prince Namughuli was granted a gold seal.
s0655.idiomatic: On yichou day Prince Namughuli was granted a gold seal.

s0656.literal: On dingmao day central secretariat officials said: "Present appointment selection and revenue-grain methods are wholly corrupted; granaries empty.
s0656.idiomatic: On dingmao day central secretariat officials said, "Present appointment selection and revenue-grain methods are wholly corrupted; granaries empty.

s0657.literal: Central Capital city construction, Dadu temple construction, and building private residences for various nobles — soldiers and commoners cannot rest.
s0657.idiomatic: Central Capital city construction, Dadu temple construction, and building private residences for various nobles — soldiers and commoners cannot rest.

s0658.literal: Recently expenditures grow ever greater — each time one person is granted, it reaches ten thousand ingots; we pray Your Majesty will examine with compassion.
s0658.idiomatic: Recently expenditures grow ever greater — each time one person is granted, it reaches 10,000 ingots; we pray Your Majesty will examine with compassion.

s0659.literal: " They also said: "For appointment selection and revenue-grain, all offices please do not interfere.
s0659.idiomatic: " They also said, "For appointment selection and revenue-grain, all offices please do not interfere.

s0660.literal: " The Emperor said: "An edict has already been issued ordering everyone not to interfere in central secretariat affairs.
s0660.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "An edict has already been issued ordering everyone not to interfere in central secretariat affairs.

s0661.literal: If someday someone taking advantage of Our momentary forgetfulness brings inner edict documents and verbal orders to the central secretariat — hold them and bring them; We shall add punishment.
s0661.idiomatic: If someday someone taking advantage of Our momentary forgetfulness brings inner edict documents and verbal orders to the central secretariat — hold them and bring them; We shall add punishment.

s0663.literal: On jisi day Chigai Puji was made right chancellor, Toghto left chancellor.
s0663.idiomatic: On jisi day Chigai Puji was made right chancellor, Toghto left chancellor.

s0664.literal: Subsequently also following Toghto's words, Tashihwa and Chigai Puji were both made right chancellors.
s0664.idiomatic: Subsequently also following Toghto's words, Tashihwa and Chigai Puji were both made right chancellors.

s0665.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "State revenue insufficient; request to trim the registers of the Bureau of Palace Provisions, Grand Treasury Bureau, Liyong Bureau, and other bureaus, fix the number due provision, and for those at Shangdu and branch secretariats, commission officials to cut.
s0665.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "State revenue insufficient; request to trim the registers of the Bureau of Palace Provisions, Grand Treasury Bureau, Liyong Bureau, and other bureaus, fix the number due provision, and for those at Shangdu and branch secretariats, commission officials to cut.

s0666.literal: Also, the Quanfu Bureau specializes in guarding treasures — private presentation of treasures should be forbidden.
s0666.idiomatic: Also, the Quanfu Bureau specializes in guarding treasures — private presentation of treasures should be forbidden.

s0667.literal: Also, throughout the empire more than one hundred twenty garrison-farm units — because those employed are mostly not the right people, leading to decay — except Sichuan, Ganzhou, Yingchang, and Yunnan as lands extremely remote, the rest should select those versed in agricultural affairs to go, with branch secretariat and pacification commission jointly going in person to inspect — cultivate where possible, abolish where possible — each compile register and report.
s0667.idiomatic: Also, throughout the empire more than 120 garrison-farm units — because those employed are mostly not the right people, leading to decay — except Sichuan, Ganzhou, Yingchang, and Yunnan as lands extremely remote, the rest should select those versed in agricultural affairs to go, with branch secretariat and pacification commission jointly going in person to inspect — cultivate where possible, abolish where possible — each compile register and report.

s0669.literal: Edict: "For Kaining Route and Xuanfu and Yunzhou corvée — supply extremely extensive — besides three years already remitted by previous edict, remit one year more.
s0669.idiomatic: Edict: "For Kaining Route and Xuanfu and Yunzhou corvée — supply extremely extensive — besides 3 years already remitted by previous edict, remit 1 year more.

s0670.literal: " On xinsi day hunting by qarachin and others in Yidu and various places was abolished.
s0670.idiomatic: " On xinsi day hunting by qarachin and others in Yidu and various places was abolished.

s0671.literal: Seven hundred fifty taels of silver, two thousand two hundred ingots of notes, and three hundred bolts of silks and cloths were donated to Haotian Temple for a water-land grand assembly.
s0671.idiomatic: 750 taels of silver, 2,200 ingots of notes, and 300 bolts of silks and cloths were donated to Haotian Temple for a water-land grand assembly.

s0672.literal: On guihai day the Empress Dowager built a temple on Wutai Mountain; six thousand five hundred soldiers were requisitioned for its corvée.
s0672.idiomatic: On guihai day the Empress Dowager built a temple on Wutai Mountain; 6,500 soldiers were requisitioned for its corvée.

s0673.literal: Intercalary eleventh month, on jichou day, because Dadu grain was expensive, granary grain of one hundred thousand shi was released at reduced price to relieve the poor.
s0673.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month, on jichou day, because Dadu grain was expensive, granary grain of 100,000 shi was released at reduced price to relieve the poor.

s0674.literal: Famine refugees from the north included those selling children; officials were ordered to redeem them.
s0674.idiomatic: Famine refugees from the north included those selling children; officials were ordered to redeem them.

s0675.literal: On weimo day the widow of former central secretariat right chancellor Wanze was granted five hundred taels of gold and one thousand five hundred taels of silver.
s0675.idiomatic: On weimo day the widow of former central secretariat right chancellor Wanze was granted 500 taels of gold and 1,500 taels of silver.

s0676.literal: On bingshen day Jiangnan tribute of granulated sugar was abolished; only wealthy commoners submitting grain for famine relief to buy office was permitted.
s0676.idiomatic: On bingshen day Jiangnan tribute of granulated sugar was abolished; only wealthy commoners submitting grain for famine relief to buy office was permitted.

s0677.literal: On dingyou day private capture of swans and geese in Jiangxi, Huguang, and Bianliang was forbidden.
s0677.idiomatic: On dingyou day private capture of swans and geese in Jiangxi, Huguang, and Bianliang was forbidden.

s0678.literal: On jihai day tribute of carved leopards from Liaoyang province was abolished.
s0678.idiomatic: On jihai day tribute of carved leopards from Liaoyang province was abolished.

s0679.literal: The Guiji Guard received as gift ten thousand private households from the Wu Jiang county darughachi; they were ordered placed under district administration.
s0679.idiomatic: The Guiji Guard received as gift 10,000 private households from the Wu Jiang county darughachi; they were ordered placed under district administration.

s0680.literal: On renyin day Chigai Puji requested grant of more than two hundred qing of Gu'an fields; approved.
s0680.idiomatic: On renyin day Chigai Puji requested grant of more than 200 qing of Gu'an fields; approved.

s0681.literal: On yisi day central secretariat officials said: "Muslim merchants holding imperial edicts, wearing tiger tallies, riding relay horses, nominally seeking rarities — then after presenting one leopard for tribute, again demanding return gifts — such cases are extremely numerous.
s0681.idiomatic: On yisi day central secretariat officials said, "Muslim merchants holding imperial edicts, wearing tiger tallies, riding relay horses, nominally seeking rarities — then after presenting one leopard for tribute, again demanding return gifts — such cases are extremely numerous.

s0682.literal: Your subjects propose: the tiger tally is the state's credential, relay horses are what envoys need — to give these to merchants is truly inappropriate; we pray all be recovered.
s0682.idiomatic: Your subjects propose: the tiger tally is the state's credential, relay horses are what envoys need — to give these to merchants is truly inappropriate; we pray all be recovered.

s0684.literal: Shunde and Guangping iron smelting intendant offices were abolished; commoners left to their own devices; officials tax as before.
s0684.idiomatic: Shunde and Guangping iron smelting intendant offices were abolished; commoners left to their own devices; officials tax as before.

s0685.literal: On dingwei day Xiangcheng County of Bianliang Route was re-established.
s0685.idiomatic: On dingwei day Xiangcheng County of Bianliang Route was re-established.

s0686.literal: Because Hangzhou, Shaoxing, Jiankang, and other routes had famine year after year, this year's liquor tax was remitted three-tenths.
s0686.idiomatic: Because Hangzhou, Shaoxing, Jiankang, and other routes had famine year after year, this year's liquor tax was remitted three-tenths.

s0687.literal: Edict: Hexi monk households follow prior dynasty fixed regulations — with military service pay taxes, the same as commoners.
s0687.idiomatic: Edict: Hexi monk households follow prior dynasty fixed regulations — with military service pay taxes, the same as commoners.

s0688.literal: On jiayin day Halaqsun Dalaqan died.
s0688.idiomatic: On jiayin day Halaqsun Dalaqan died.

s0689.literal: Twelfth month, on gengshen day Holangsa was enfeoffed as Prince of Long and granted a gold seal.
s0689.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengshen day, Holangsa was enfeoffed as Prince of Long and granted a gold seal.

s0690.literal: Commoners in Pingjiang Route attached to Jindili's following — per old regulations, corvée and levies same as commoners equally borne.
s0690.idiomatic: Commoners in Pingjiang Route attached to Jindili's following — per old regulations, corvée and levies same as commoners equally borne.

s0691.literal: One thousand Uighurs of Yunnan dwelt in Jingxiang; Yunnan branch secretariat officials said: "Shizu had an edict ordering them to return to Yunnan to assist in campaigns.
s0691.idiomatic: 1,000 Uighurs of Yunnan dwelt in Jingxiang; Yunnan branch secretariat officials said, "Shizu had an edict ordering them to return to Yunnan to assist in campaigns.

s0692.literal: " Central secretariat officials deliberated that dispatching them back was correct; approved.
s0692.idiomatic: " Central secretariat officials deliberated that dispatching them back was correct; approved.

s0693.literal: Kaining County was established in the Central Capital; Longxing was demoted to Yuan Prefecture; Wei Prefecture was promoted to Weichang Prefecture.
s0693.idiomatic: Kaining County was established in the Central Capital; Longxing was demoted to Yuan Prefecture; Wei Prefecture was promoted to Weichang Prefecture.

s0694.literal: Hedong pacification commission was abolished; Datong Route was placed under the Central Capital resident commission; Jining and Jinning routes were placed under the central secretariat.
s0694.idiomatic: Hedong pacification commission was abolished; Datong Route was placed under the Central Capital resident commission; Jining and Jinning routes were placed under the central secretariat.

s0695.literal: On jiaxu day pingzhang political affairs negotiator of central secretariat affairs and Crown Prince guest Wang Taiheng was made acting Crown Prince household superintendent; pingzhang military and state weighty affairs and Crown Prince junior household superintendent Daci was made Crown Prince household superintendent.
s0695.idiomatic: On jiaxu day pingzhang political affairs negotiator of central secretariat affairs and Crown Prince guest Wang Taiheng was made acting Crown Prince household superintendent; pingzhang military and state weighty affairs and Crown Prince junior household superintendent Daci was made Crown Prince household superintendent.

s0696.literal: Banquet robes were granted to censorate officials and surveillance censors.
s0696.idiomatic: Banquet robes were granted to censorate officials and surveillance censors.
